title: Build a Web3 App - Part 2 - How to Mint a Token or NFT
summary: Learn how to mint an NFT or Token in under 10 minutes using the DropChain API. Building a web3 doesn't have to be hard.
author: Carter Razink
body:
Join Carter Razink, CEO and co-founder of DropChain, in this insightful tutorial on how to mint your first NFT or token using the DropChain API. Whether you're a coder or prefer a no-code approach, this guide ensures you grasp the essentials of creating a token or NFT without the need for extensive Web3 knowledge or dealing with smart contracts and gas fees.

‍

🛠 What You Will Learn:

How to use both code and no-code approaches to build with DropChain.

The process of setting up your asset and defining its properties.

Minting your asset securely and efficiently with DropChain.
